source_note: Expert episode 32 (layout 40 / style 17, onion -> plate). Expert grasped at fingertips (47, 5, 74) with fingers down and released at (26, 46, 94). The plan below follows these key events; verified with the executor: success after 347 steps.
note: The object lies in the sink basin, below the counter; the plate (container) is on the counter beside the sink. Grasp from above around the object's middle height, lift clear of the counter, transport in short steps, lower until just above the plate, release, then move the gripper more than 25 cm away. A first attempt that grasped 3 cm above the middle dropped the object during a fast 20 cm sideways move.

turns.scene: An onion lies in the sink basin straight ahead (about forward 44, left -1); the sink bottom is ~20 cm below the counter top. The plate is on the counter to the left (about forward 30, left 48).
turns.plan: Point the fingers down and move out over the object.

turns.scene: Fingertips above the object, high above the sink.
turns.plan: Descend into the sink until the fingertips are at the object's middle height (grasp around its centre, not its top).

turns.scene: Wrist camera: the object is centred between the open fingers.

turns.plan: Lift it well above the counter top before moving sideways.
Carry it towards the plate in 10 cm steps so it does not slip: a little back and to the left.
Finish the transport until the object is above the plate centre.
Lower it until it is just above the plate, then release.

turns.scene: Object resting on the plate, gripper open.
turns.plan: Move the gripper well away (the check requires more than 25 cm between gripper and object): up and back.
